idea-plugin.name: Git Identity Guard
idea-plugin.description:
English

Git Identity Guard prevents an unintended Git name or email address from being recorded in commits to your GitHub repositories.

The plugin uses the GitHub accounts already configured in IntelliJ IDEA and protects repositories whose GitHub.com remote owner matches one of those accounts.

  • Resolves and caches the GitHub no-reply email for each configured account.
  • Checks the effective user.name and user.email when a project opens, when repository remotes change, and before a commit.
  • Offers one-click actions to apply the privacy identity or ignore a repository.
  • Writes only repository-local Git configuration and only after explicit confirmation.
  • Provides English and Simplified Chinese user interfaces based on the IDE language.

Privacy: Identity comparisons happen locally. GitHub API requests reuse credentials managed by IntelliJ IDEA, and the plugin contains no telemetry.

Current scope: GitHub.com repositories owned by a configured personal account. GitHub Enterprise Server, organization-owned repositories, and SSH host aliases are not currently protected.

简体中文

Git Identity Guard 用于防止错误的 Git 用户名或邮箱被写入 GitHub 仓库的提交记录。

插件直接使用 IntelliJ IDEA 中已配置的 GitHub 账号，并保护 GitHub.com Remote owner 与其中某个账号匹配的仓库。

  • 获取并缓存每个账号的 GitHub no-reply 隐私邮箱。
  • 在项目打开、仓库 Remote 变化及 Commit 前检查最终生效的 user.name 和 user.email。
  • 提供一键应用隐私身份或忽略仓库的操作。
  • 只有在用户明确确认后才写入仓库级 Git 配置。
  • 根据 IDE 语言提供英文或简体中文界面。

隐私说明：所有身份比对均在本地完成。GitHub API 请求复用 IntelliJ IDEA 管理的凭据，插件不包含遥测功能。

当前范围：仅保护已配置个人账号名下的 GitHub.com 仓库；暂不保护 GitHub Enterprise Server、组织名下的仓库和使用 SSH 主机别名的 Remote。

idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0 - English

  • Initial release.
  • GitHub account matching and no-reply email resolution.
  • Identity mismatch notifications and pre-commit protection.
  • Repository-local identity updates, ignore rules, lenient mode, and email allowlists.
  • English and Simplified Chinese localization.

0.1.0 - 简体中文

  • 首次发布。
  • 支持 GitHub 账号匹配与 no-reply 隐私邮箱解析。
  • 支持身份不匹配通知和 Commit 前保护。
  • 支持仓库级身份更新、忽略规则、宽松模式和邮箱白名单。
  • 提供英文和简体中文本地化。
